description.value: Small BC Parks campground on Upper Arrow Lake in the Kootenays, sitting close to the free Shelter Bay–Galena Bay ferry crossing; washrooms and potable water on site, but no services outside the operating season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies Shelter Bay Campground as a 17-site fee-based BC Parks campground on Arrow Lakes in the Kootenays, operated by West Kootenay Park Management Inc. The fetched website is the BC Parks Arrow Lakes Park overview page; it loaded but contains only site-wide navigation text and no campground-specific amenity details—all subpages returned 404. The website does confirm this is a real, active BC Parks property with a prominent 'Book camping' link and a Reservations section covering frontcountry camping, supporting reservations being accepted; all other amenity fields remain null for lack of evidence.
concerns: Website URL resolves to the general Arrow Lakes Park overview page only—no campground-specific page was found and all subpages returned 404, so no amenity details for Shelter Bay specifically could be extracted.
Phone number (+1-866-937-5734) and email (info@westkootenayparks.com) are for operator West Kootenay Park Management Inc. and could not be confirmed or contradicted by the website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active BC Parks campground on Arrow Lakes; a legitimate and useful overnight stop for touring cyclists in a remote section of the Kootenays.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags record internet_access=no and capacity=17. BC Parks website mentions a Senior Camping Discount and Social Services Camping Fee Exemption but no cyclist-specific discount.

wow_evidence: close to the free Shelter Bay–Galena Bay ferry crossing
